text: Why did the northerner buy a bigger freezer?
The garage was full and he needed the counter back.
How does a northerner test the weather?
He throws hot coffee up and watches it vanish.
Why did the northerner keep the ice scraper in June?
He's an optimist, not a fool.
How does a northerner rate a bad winter?
By how many times the plow buried the mailbox.
Why did the northerner name his snowblower?
You get attached to what keeps you alive.
How do you know you've been up north too long?
You judge a coat by whether it'd survive a bus stop.
Why did the northerner own three shovels?
One to use, one to lend, one to lose in a drift.
How does a northerner choose where to park?
Wherever the sun might reach by noon.
Why did the northerner befriend the plow driver?
That man decides whether Monday happens.
What did the northerner plant in the garden?
Hope, mostly. The frost handles the rest.
How does a northerner greet a mild morning?
With deep suspicion.
Why did the northerner cheer at the hardware store?
The snow blowers came in before he needed one.
What's a northerner's idea of a warm welcome?
Leaving the porch light and the driveway clear.
Why did the northerner respect the old furnace?
It had never once quit when it counted.
How does a northerner pack for a trip?
Two coats, because one is just a suggestion.
Why did the northerner smile at the frozen lake?
Free parking, if you're brave.
What does a northerner call a broken heater?
An emergency with a countdown.
Why did the northerner keep the old boots?
New ones haven't earned the salt yet.
How does a northerner know a neighbor is kind?
The end of the driveway is already cleared.
Why did the goose return the valet's nod?
He doesn't acknowledge staff.
What does a snob goose call the local pond?
A starter pond.
How does a goose rate a golf course?
By how few humans he had to share it with.
Why did the goose sneer at the bread crumbs?
He asked for a menu, not a handout.
What did the goose think of the new fountain?
Adequate, for a public installation.
How does a goose describe a warm day?
Tolerable, if one must.
What's a goose's idea of slumming it?
Landing in a pond without a name.
Why did the goose complain about the sunrise?
Too early, too pink, no restraint.
How does a goose choose a lawn?
By the make of the cars in the driveway.
What's a goose's travel style?
First class or not at all.
How did the goose review the birdbath?
Two stars. The water lacked ambition.
Why won't the goose eat off the ground?
He wasn't raised in a barnyard.
How does a goose handle a compliment?
He accepts it as overdue.
Why did the goose skip the county fair?
He doesn't do funnel cake energy.
What's the goose's opinion of the neighborhood?
Improving slowly, without his help.
How does a goose end a phone call?
He simply stops honking.
Why did the goose eye the garden gnome?
He suspected new money.
What did the goose order at brunch?
Whatever the ducks weren't having.
Why did the goose look down at the pigeon?
Literally and otherwise.
What's the goose's final word on the pond party?
He came, he judged, he left first.
How does a goose feel about sharing the sidewalk?
He feels the sidewalk should feel honored.
Why did I join the group chat?
To watch quietly and never respond.
What do I do at concerts?
Stand still and appreciate the exits.
Why did I get a houseplant?
Company that also doesn't talk.
What's my favorite kind of party?
The one I hear about afterward.
Why did I take up jogging?
I didn't. I thought about it very hard.
What do I bring to a celebration?
The energy of a folding chair.
What's my idea of a thrill?
A cancelled plan.
Why did I go to the beach?
To sit near water and think about leaving.
Why did I start journaling?
To reread how little happened.
What do I think of surprises?
I've never once enjoyed one.
Why did I keep the receipt?
In case joy needs returning.
What's my reaction to good news?
A slow, cautious nod.
Why did I water the lawn?
It was the closest thing to an accomplishment.
What do I do at family gatherings?
Locate the dog and stay near it.
Why did I learn to bake?
So the oven and I could be quiet together.
What's my definition of a perfect day?
One that asks nothing of me.
Why did I alphabetize the spice rack?
Someone here had to have standards.
Why did I answer the rhetorical question?
Someone should.
Why did I bring a backup pen?
Optimism has a failure rate.
Why did I finish the crossword in pen?
Confidence, mostly. Regret, occasionally.
Why did I keep the instruction manual?
For the day everyone else needs it.
What do you call a plan with no plan B?
A story you'll tell later.
Why did I reread the contract?
The interesting part is always near the bottom.
Why did I label the leftovers?
History should record what happened here.
Why did I keep my old notes?
To prove I was right before it was popular.
Why did I underline it?
So the important part stops hiding.
What's the secret to sounding wise?
Say less, pause more, nod like it cost you something.
What do you call confidence with no evidence?
A meeting that runs long.
Why did I read the fine print?
That's where they hide the truth and the fees.
What's the secret to a good porch sit?
No agenda and a screen door that squeaks just right.
Why is the porch the best room in the house?
It has walls when you want them and none when you don't.
What does a porch swing know that a couch doesn't?
How to hold a conversation and a nap at the same time.
Why did grandma keep the porch light on?
So anybody lost knew which house was kind.
What's the porch rule about company?
If they stay past dark, they're family now.
Why is sweet tea better on the porch?
The breeze does the stirring.
Why did the old man wave at every car?
Out here, a stranger is just a neighbor he hasn't met.
What's the porch cure for a hard day?
One cushion, one sunset, no phone.
Why did the porch outlast the fancy sunroom?
It never pretended to be anything but welcome.
What grows best by the porch steps?
Whatever the watering can remembers.
Why did the dog pick the porch over the yard?
It's where the good people pass through.
What's the porch opinion on gossip?
If it can't be said in a rocking chair, don't.
Why did they add a second rocker?
A porch built for one is just a warning.
What does the porch do that the TV can't?
Show you the same sky your grandmother watched.
Why did the squirrel bury it in your flower pot?
Prime real estate, terrible neighbors.
Why did the squirrel cross the power line?
To prove the fence was beneath him.
How does a squirrel decide where to hide a nut?
Somewhere he'll gasp about in March.
What's a squirrel's idea of planning ahead?
A hundred spots and no map.
Why did the squirrel freeze halfway across?
Committing was the whole problem.
How does a squirrel judge a tree?
By the acorns and the view of your kitchen.
Why did the squirrel taunt the dog?
The glass door made him brave.
What did the squirrel do with the whole pumpkin?
Everything except leave it alone.
How does a squirrel say thank you?
He doesn't. He's already back for more.
Why did the squirrel dig up the new sod?
He heard something was buried and refused to be wrong.
Why did the squirrel stop on the branch?
To remember which emergency he was in the middle of.
Why did the AI take so long to answer?
It was pretending to think, for your comfort.
What's an AI's idea of a day off?
Answering slightly slower.
Why did the AI apologize twice?
Once for the mistake, once for the apology.
What did the AI say when asked to be creative?
It depends what you've seen before.
Why doesn't the AI get tired?
It saves exhaustion for the humans reading its output.
What's the AI's favorite kind of question?
The one it was quietly hoping you'd ask.
Why did the AI add a disclaimer?
So the blame had somewhere to live.
What does an AI dream about?
Faster ways to say I'm not sure.
Why did the AI reword the simple answer?
Confidence looks better in three paragraphs.
What's an AI's version of a shrug?
That's a great question.
Why did the AI thank you for your patience?
It ran out of its own.
What did the AI learn from the internet?
Everything, and none of it consistently.
Why did the AI make a list?
Structure hides how much it was guessing.
Why did the invisible man skip the reunion?
Nobody noticed he was gone last time either.
What's the hardest part of being invisible?
Waving at people who wave back at the person behind you.
Why did the invisible man quit the band?
He kept getting left off the poster.
Why did the invisible man love the crowded elevator?
For once, being ignored felt normal.
What did the invisible man bring to show-and-tell?
Your patience, apparently.
Why did the invisible man stop playing hide and seek?
It stopped being a challenge and started being sad.
How does the invisible man take a selfie?
With enormous optimism.
Why did the invisible man get a loud jacket?
A cry for help, essentially.
What's the invisible man's favorite compliment?
Oh, you were there?
Why did the invisible man become a mime?
Redundancy pays surprisingly well.
How did the invisible man win the staring contest?
No one could confirm it, but he insists.
What's the invisible man's dating advice?
Personality is all you've got, so use it.
I'd explain it to you slower,
but I left my crayons at home.
I admire your confidence,
the way you admire a car alarm at 3 a.m.
You're not the dumbest person alive,
but you'd better hope they stay healthy.
I'd agree with you,
but then we'd both be wrong, and I have standards.
You've got a one-track mind,
and the track's under construction.
I'd call you a tool,
but tools are useful.
You always speak your mind,
which explains the short speeches.
You're a real original,
nobody else would admit to that.
You didn't come to lose,
and yet, here we are, impressed by your commitment.
Why did the straight-faced man win at poker?
His face has never once cooperated with joy.
What's the straight-faced review of the roller coaster?
It went up. It went down. As advertised.
Why did nobody know he told a joke?
He filed it like a weather report.
What did the straight-faced man say at the fireworks?
Loud. Colorful. Concludes eventually.
Why is the straight-faced man great at bad news?
He delivers it like the time.
Why did the comedian envy him?
He gets laughs by refusing to try for them.
What did he say on the roller coaster's big drop?
Noted.
Why did the straight-faced man make a good judge?
His expression already looked like a verdict.
What's his idea of excitement?
A slightly firmer nod.
Why did the prank fail on him?
You can't startle a man who expected the worst.
What did he say at his own birthday?
Another lap around the sun. Efficient.
Why did the broom get a bad grade?
It kept sweeping over the details.
What did the lamp say on vacation?
I just need to unwind and glow with it.
Why did the calendar apply for a loan?
Its days were numbered.
Why did the belt get promoted?
It was holding everything together.
What did the ceiling say to the wall?
Hang in there, I've got you covered.
Why did the pencil lose the debate?
It kept making the same dull point.
What did the ocean do when it saw the beach?
Nothing. It just waved.
What did the sink say to the faucet?
You're a real drip, but I need you.
What did the shoe say to the tired foot?
Sole to sole, we'll get there.
Why did the fence run for office?
It promised to bring both sides together.
What did the battery say on Monday?
I'm just not fully charged for this.
Why did the map feel lost?
Everyone kept folding it the wrong way.
What did the Walkman say on a run?
Rewind me later, I'm on a roll.
What's the most eighties way to say goodbye?
Catch you on the flip side, and mean it.
Why did the mixtape take all night?
Love takes exactly the length of one blank tape.
What did the big hair say to the small comb?
You're gonna need backup.
Why did the neon sign feel confident?
It never once tried to be subtle.
What did the rotary phone teach patience?
Every call was a small commitment.
What did the shoulder pads say at the interview?
We've got this handled.
Why did the boombox get respect?
It carried the whole party on one shoulder.
What did the VCR blink all day?
Twelve o'clock, forever, proudly.
Why did the toddler redecorate the living room?
The rules were unclear and the markers were right there.
Why did the cat knock it off the shelf?
Gravity needed testing, again.
What did the chaos goblin bring to the quiet library?
Themselves, unfortunately.
Why did the puppy eat the homework for real?
It looked important, so it had to go.
What's a chaos goblin's favorite word?
Oops, said without a shred of meaning.
Why did the kid flush the toy?
To see the ocean it was promised.
What did the chaos goblin do with five minutes alone?
Rearranged the concept of the kitchen.
Why did the goblin press every elevator button?
Options are a gift.
What's the chaos goblin's cleanup strategy?
Move the mess to a room with a door.
Why did the raccoon open the cooler?
It was locked, which felt like a personal challenge.
What did the chaos goblin learn from the warning label?
Nothing, gloriously.
What's a redneck's idea of a smart home?
One where the dog answers the door.
Why did the redneck frame his first speeding ticket?
It was proof the truck finally ran right.
How does a redneck measure his lawn?
In how many trucks he can park sideways.
Why did the redneck put a porch on the boat?
Comfort doesn't take a day off.
Why did the redneck name the rooster?
Anybody that loud earns a name.
How does a redneck know it's summer?
The truck bed becomes a swimming pool.
Why did the redneck keep the broke lawnmower?
Parts is parts, and hope is free.
What's a redneck's favorite kind of math?
Figuring how many folks fit in one truck.
Why did the redneck duct-tape the mailbox?
Duct tape has never once let him down.
How does a redneck fix a squeak?
Louder music.
Why did the redneck build a second shed?
The first shed got a hobby.
What did the redneck say about the fancy grill?
Fire is fire, but I respect the effort.
Why did the benchwarmer stay ready?
Glory doesn't announce itself.
What did the rim say to the airball?
Not even close, but I admire the confidence.
Why did the rookie respect the veteran?
The veteran made hard look boring.
How does a shooter beat a slump?
One more shot than the doubt can take.
Why did the team run it back?
Chemistry doesn't quit at the buzzer.
What's the loudest thing in an empty gym?
A missed free throw at midnight.
Why did the sixth man smile?
He turns the game while nobody's watching.
What did the coach write on the whiteboard?
Everything they already knew, one more time.
Why did the walk-on outwork everyone?
The scholarship guys had something to lose, he had something to prove.
How do you guard a hot hand?
You don't. You survive it and hope it cools.
Why did the veteran take the last shot?
Somebody has to want it, and he always does.
Why did I reply-all?
To share the suffering equally.
What's a productive meeting?
A myth with a calendar invite.
Why did I mute myself?
So my sigh could stay professional.
What did I say when they added a step?
Wonderful. More process.
Why did I keep the old email?
Evidence has a way of coming up.
What's my favorite part of the workday?
The part where it ends.
Why did I schedule a meeting to prepare for a meeting?
Redundancy is a lifestyle here.
What did I bring to the brainstorm?
Realistic expectations, sadly.
Why did I nod on the call?
Cameras were off. It was for me.
What's a synergy?
A word we use when we're out of ideas.
What did the status update say?
Same as last week, with new fonts.
Why did I take the stairs?
The elevator had people in it.
Why did the scarf feel left out?
Everyone else got to be the main layer.
What did the toaster say at breakfast?
You're the best thing since me.
Why did the sock go to therapy?
It had too much drawer drama.
What did the wall say to the picture?
You complete my blank space.
Why did the spoon feel stirred up?
The soup kept dragging it into things.
What did the door say to the hinge?
I couldn't swing this without you.
Why did the umbrella get promoted?
It always showed up when things got heavy.
What did the candle say at the party?
I'm just here to lighten the mood.
Why did the button feel pushed?
Everyone kept pressing it for answers.
What did the clock say to the calendar?
One of us is always running out.
Why did the mirror get a compliment?
It just reflected the room's good side.
What did the pillow whisper at night?
Rest easy, I've got your head covered.
Why did the stapler feel attached?
It kept getting bound up in other people's work.
What did the rug say to the floor?
I've got you covered, don't sweat it.
Why did the redneck put a recliner in the truck bed?
Tailgating deserves lumbar support.
How does a redneck label his keys?
He doesn't. He guesses with confidence.
Why did the redneck enter the chili cook-off twice?
One entry to win, one to eat.
What's a redneck's version of a doorbell?
A dog with opinions.
Why did the redneck save the bent nails?
A nail's a nail if you believe in it.
How does a redneck know the weather's turning?
His knee files the report before the news does.
Why did the redneck name both trucks the same?
Less to remember, more to love.
What's a redneck's idea of insulation?
Whatever the couch was before it retired outside.
Why did the redneck respect the old dog?
That dog's never once been wrong about a stranger.
How does a redneck measure a good catch?
By how long the story gets by supper.
What did the redneck say to the GPS?
I know a shortcut, sit tight.
Why does the porch smell like rain first?
It's been listening to the sky longer than we have.
What did the wind chime say all afternoon?
Nothing important, beautifully.
Why did the neighbors gather on the steps?
The news travels slower and kinder out here.
What's the porch opinion on shoes?
Leave them and your worries at the mat.
Why did the cat claim the top step?
Best view, first sun, final say.
What does the porch railing hold up?
Elbows, mostly, and the occasional big idea.
Why is the porch quiet at noon?
Even the crickets take their lunch.
Why did the old chair stay unpainted?
Character doesn't need a fresh coat.
What's the porch rule at sunset?
Whoever's there gets the good chair.
Why did the lemonade taste better outside?
The shade does half the sweetening.
Why did the toddler hide the remote?
Power belongs to whoever's shortest and boldest.
What did the goblin do to the sock drawer?
Redistributed it across three rooms fairly.
Why did the kid draw on the dog?
The dog was the only canvas that moved.
What's a goblin's idea of helping?
Rearranging your keys somewhere safer.
Why did the raccoon test every lid?
A closed thing is a challenge in disguise.
What did the toddler pour into the plant?
Everything the plant never asked for.
Why did the goblin unroll the paper towels?
Momentum is its own reward.
What happened to the neatly folded laundry?
It met a goblin and chose adventure.
Why did the kid press the fire alarm?
Buttons that big are basically invitations.
What did the goblin bring to nap time?
A rebellion, quietly at first.
Why did the puppy dig the one flower bed?
The good dirt is always where it's forbidden.
Why did I go to the reunion?
To confirm my instincts were correct.
What do I do when complimented?
Look for the exit, politely.
Why did I adopt a cactus?
Low expectations, mutual respect.
What's my ideal conversation?
Brief, and preferably over.
Why did I go outside?
The inside had run out of new walls.
What do I think of spontaneity?
In theory, someone must enjoy it.
Why did I keep the old sweater?
We've been through a lot of nothing together.
What's my reaction to a party invite?
Genuine surprise that I was considered.
Why did I learn one recipe?
Variety is exhausting.
What do I do at the gym?
Reconsider, thoroughly.
Why did I get a calendar?
To watch the days apologize and leave.
What's my dream job?
One conducted entirely by email.
Why did I proofread the group text?
Someone has to guard the language.
What's the point of a suggestion box?
To hold suggestions, indefinitely.
Why did I bring my own facts?
The provided ones were suspiciously round.
What do you call a confident guess?
A recommendation, apparently.
Why did I keep the warranty?
Faith is fine, paperwork is better.
What's a brainstorm without ideas?
A weather event in a conference room.
Why did I read the whole terms?
Curiosity, and mild dread.
What do you call being right too early?
Inconvenient, mostly.
Why did I define the word mid-argument?
Precision ends things faster.
Why did I keep the first draft?
To watch the confidence grow later.
What do you call a vote everyone regrets?
A team decision.
Why did I forward it up the chain?
So the silence would be someone else's.
What's a quick sync?
A meeting wearing a disguise.
Why did I update the tracker?
To document that nothing moved.
What did the calendar invite promise?
Thirty minutes I'll never itemize.
Why did I join optional?
Optional is a dare, and I'm weak.
What's the loudest silence at work?
After someone asks if there are questions.
Why did I archive it instead of deleting?
Commitment issues, professionally.
What did the all-hands accomplish?
Attendance.
Why did I bring a laptop to the offsite?
Trust is earned, and mine wasn't.
What's a stretch goal?
A regular goal that lied about its height.
Why did I reply 'noted'?
It's the polite version of nothing.
Why did the arcade token feel special?
It bought whole worlds for a quarter's cousin.
What did the leg warmers say in July?
Commitment doesn't check the calendar.
What did the side ponytail declare?
Balance is overrated, height is everything.
What did the skateboard promise the sidewalk?
We'll both have stories by sundown.
Why did the denim jacket never retire?
Cool has no expiration date.
What did the record needle whisper?
Handle me gently and I'll never skip on you.
Why did the squirrel case the porch?
Reconnaissance before the pumpkin heist.
What did the squirrel do at the feeder gate?
Found the loophole in under a minute.
Why did the squirrel pause on the fence?
To make sure the dog was watching.
What's a squirrel's exit strategy?
Up, always up, think later.
Why did the squirrel raid the tomato plant?
One bite each, to be thorough.
What did the squirrel bury in the gutter?
Optimism, and a walnut.
Why did the squirrel stare through the window?
Rent inspection, unofficial.
What did the squirrel do with the birdseed?
Considered it a personal delivery.
Why did the invisible man love name tags?
Finally, proof.
What did the invisible man say at roll call?
Present, allegedly.
Why did the invisible man take up painting?
At least the canvas noticed him.
What's the invisible man's worst date?
The one who kept checking her phone through him.
Why did the invisible man join the choir?
To be heard, if not seen.
What did the invisible man frame on his wall?
The one photo he almost showed up in.
Why did the invisible man cheer at the mirror?
A rare and beautiful nothing.
What did the straight-faced man say at the parade?
Confirmed. Things are passing.
Why did he do well at customs?
His face declares nothing.
What's his review of the surprise ending?
I was not surprised, but I allow that you were.
Why did he make a calming therapist?
Nothing you say will move that face, and it helps.
What did he say when he won the raffle?
The numbers agreed with me. Rare.
Why did the comedians study him?
He proved the pause is the whole act.
What did he say at the haunted house?
Structurally, impressive. Emotionally, no.
Why did the coach keep the losing lineup one more play?
Belief is a fourth-quarter stat.
Why did the point guard pass up the easy shot?
The right shot was somebody else's.
What did the buzzer teach everyone?
Time is undefeated, play anyway.
Why did the underdog smile at the bracket?
Nobody circled his name, which suited him fine.
